name: Egan Kilbane
tagline: Top rated Medical Malpractice attorney in Seattle, Washington
education: University of Cincinnati College of Law
about: Egan brings a uniquely sophisticated perspective to the team at Elk + Elk. Licensed to practice in both Washington and Ohio, he is a principal attorney who manages a robust caseload across both venues. As a lead advocate for the Seattle-Tacoma office, Egan provides a bridge between two distinct legal landscapes, offering his clients a depth of knowledge that spans the Pacific Northwest and the Midwest. His practice is centered on representing individuals and families whose lives have been devastated by medical negligence and catastrophic trucking or automobile accidents.

With decades of collective firm experience at Elk + Elk serving as a foundation for his work, Egan has built a career defined by an insider's understanding of the legal system. This understanding was forged in the early years of his career when he worked at a respected medical malpractice and insurance defense firm. During this time, he gained invaluable insight into the methods insurance companies and healthcare corporations use to evaluate and defend injury claims. This experience allows him to anticipate the opposition's strategies and build cases that are specifically engineered to withstand the tactics of well-funded defense teams.

In addition to his defense background, Egan served as a Judicial Staff Attorney for the Cuyahoga County Court of Common Pleas. In this role, he assisted Judge Harry Hanna, Judge Leo Spellacy, and former Ohio Supreme Court Justice Francis E. Sweeney. Working directly with the judiciary provided Egan with a behind-the-bench view of how legal arguments are perceived by the court. He learned firsthand what makes an argument persuasive to a judge and how the procedural nuances of a case can influence its final outcome. This rare combination of defense experience and judicial service gives Egan's clients a significant advantage in the courtroom, as he understands the law from the perspective of the advocate, the adversary, and the court itself.

Egan's commitment to excellence has been recognized by his peers in both of his practicing states. He was honored as a Washington Super Lawyers Rising Star from 2016 through 2019 and was named to the Washington Super Lawyers list in 2020, 2022, and 2023. Prior to his work in Washington, he was recognized as an Ohio Super Lawyers Rising Star from 2010 to 2015. This distinction is given to no more than 2.5 percent of the attorneys in a state, marking Egan as a standout practitioner in two different regions of the country. These accolades reflect a career of consistent, high-level performance and a reputation for integrity among fellow trial lawyers.

In the complex arena of medical negligence, Egan's meticulous approach is vital. Medical malpractice cases require a deep dive into clinical records, hospital protocols, and expert testimony. Egan's ability to deconstruct these cases ensures that negligent healthcare providers are held accountable for their actions. He approaches these cases with a fierce determination to secure justice for patients who have been harmed by sub-standard medical care.

When handling trucking and automobile negligence claims, Egan applies his understanding of both federal and state regulations to ensure no stone is left unturned. Whether it is a high-speed collision on a Washington highway or a complex commercial truck accident in Ohio, he understands the physics and the liability issues that define these life-altering events. He believes that every client deserves a champion who is not only a skilled litigator but also a compassionate advisor who can guide them through the physical and financial recovery process.

Egan's dual-state practice is a testament to his versatility and his tireless work ethic. He balances the demands of two distinct legal systems while maintaining the high standards of Elk + Elk. For Egan, the practice of law is not just a profession but a calling to serve those who have been wronged. He is dedicated to ensuring that insurance companies and large corporations fulfill their obligations to the injured, and he remains a steadfast advocate for the rights of the individual in every case he accepts.
